comparison.objective: Insert a cable-bound USB-C plug into a handheld spot welder and set the assembled device down.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual device stabilization and submillimetre connector alignment under cable stiffness.
comparison.success_condition: Plug body is within 1.5 mm of the device face, within 0.5 mm of port center, under 8 degrees tilt, then both objects are released and arms return home.
comparison.reason: It shares coaxial precision and bimanual stabilization but centrally tests tight connector insertion, not impact-force control, breakage at a notch, or fragment recovery.
